description: The logme spec leaves these fields as plain strings. `uri` on Credentials and CredentialsResponse is the connection URI holding the password: STACKIT's Terraform provider marks it Sensitive (docs/resources/logme_credential.md, read 2026-11-01). `encryption_key` on the backups config is, by its name, the key that encrypts backups. `metrics_prefix` on InstanceParameters: the spec's own description says it may hold an API key. `syslog_drain_url` on Credentials is an unverified format: a drain URL of this kind can carry the user and password, so it gets the same treatment. Nothing on the wire changes. No live probe: no credentials exist for this account.
